scope: Repair confirmed engineering failure-diagnostic erasure; preserve historical unknown cause, immutable facts, usage and independent bounded cleanup. No paid execution or permission expansion.
riskAnalysis: Diagnostics are new trusted metadata surfaces in the existing transport and shared CAS broker. Strict closed vocabulary, schema-derived paths, server-owned correlation and independent cleanup prevent content leakage or evidence substitution.

threatModel.assets: Credentials, immutable source/request/evidence identities, model results, observed usage and revocation state.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Untrusted provider output and exceptions to trusted transport facts, capability-bound existing journal and authenticated owner readback.
threatModel.abuseCases: Secret-bearing errors or schema keys, forged ticket identity, diagnostic overwrite, storage stalls, cancellation and lost finish acknowledgement.
threatModel.mitigations: Closed enums and schema paths, safe scalar facts, first-write-only receipts, server-derived bindings, separate two-second diagnostic and cleanup limits, unchanged parser/authority/financial controls.

rollback: Disable paid/count flags and revoke exact authority before reverting diagnostic-only increment. Preserve all historical receipts, reservations, pending uncertainty and original failed trial.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Wrong object/fields, noninteger/oversized counts and secret echo fail closed before Responses dispatch.
negativePaths.stale-state: Source/context/request/expiry and authoritative stored approval mismatch deny dispatch.
negativePaths.concurrency: Count dispatch and count recording are one-use existing-CAS operations; duplicate winners cannot occur.
negativePaths.cancellation: Shared owner/task/revoke/lease checks run after counting and before dispatch; whole-operation abort includes count requests.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Bounded abortAdmission retains pending ceilings and reports cleanup uncertainty; no paid retry.
negativePaths.api-outage: Fixed endpoint/redirect:error, bounded response body, deadline and sanitized status/hash diagnostics; no fallback or retry.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Missing count consent/server pricing pin, impersonated roles or substituted workspace/source deny; no model-granted permissions.
negativePaths.spending-limit: At most five count and five Responses dispatches, existing 1USD retained internal ceiling. Unknown counts remain pending/null; known Responses usage separate; no invoice cap claimed.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Successful count alone cannot settle or accept work. Responses usage mismatch leaves pending evidence/reservation; no generated source execution or publication.

defects.rootCause: Generic catch discarded the original failure code and phase. Exact historical Specialist cause remains unknown.
defects.detectionGap: Pre-existing fixtures verified generic failure and cleanup but not actionable retained classifications or schema locations.
defects.regression: Independent offline valid/malformed Specialist, schema/semantic/partial/refusal, cancellation/timeout, store failures and immutable capability-bound diagnostics; Redis diagnostic/cleanup race.
defects.historicalPrevention: Keep failure taxonomy and safe structural metadata independently from accepted output, and test storage outages without paid diagnostic retries.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing transport/provider/profile shared-CAS journal only; no new orchestrator, credentials, reviewer role or authority.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Pinned provider request schema and existing source evidence; new failure helper participates in source release fingerprint and tracing.
proactiveReview.threats: Provider text, exception messages and arbitrary object keys must never reach logs, model authority or owner decisions as trusted instructions.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Unknown historical root cause remains unknown. Persistent storage outage can prevent durable diagnostic writes; report failure explicitly and independently revoke authority.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: 24 independent QA fixtures plus existing real five-stage fixture transport, owner control and token/revocation tests; disposable Redis concurrent diagnostic/cleanup race.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work QA and Engineering Auditor found no material issue; technical review does not establish human acceptance or approve another paid trial.
proactiveReview.recovery: No paid requests, retries, new reservations or reset of consumed exception. Keep all original pending charges and history unchanged.
proactiveReview.readiness: Exact-source STRICT, Redis, CI, CodeQL and authenticated Preview qualification required before final published checkpoint; second live trial still requires fresh exact owner consent.
